target_population: every station worldwide that can be lawfully and reproducibly accessed without paid data access

identity_policy.canonical_station_id: stable opaque identity derived from one immutable root provider alias; later provider aliases are explicit crosswalk bindings and do not mutate the canonical id
identity_policy.cross_provider_deduplication: explicit provider crosswalk/evidence only; geographic proximity is never sufficient identity evidence
identity_policy.location_history: resolved non-overlapping epochs with source alias and source-artifact digest; conflicting provider locations remain unresolved upstream

storage_policy.catalog: content-addressed bounded catalog shards referenced by manifest; no global station table is required in memory
storage_policy.observations: content-addressed provider/time/variable/spatial partitions with explicit supersession or tombstones
storage_policy.ingestion: idempotent by artifact digest; source revisions append lineage rather than overwrite prior artifacts
storage_policy.coverage: derived from active manifest references so station/provider/variable/time/spatial gaps remain observable

providers.scale_path: complete ghcnd-stations.txt and ghcnd-inventory.txt provider artifacts feed bounded content-addressed catalog shards; yearly observation acquisition uses resumable byte-range capture of the provider by_year archive bound to a stable remote validator and final SHA-256 digest, while subset REST remains a captured-fixture/reference path rather than the worldwide ingestion loop
providers.access: NCEI HTTPS archive and Common Access Data/Search Service REST APIs
providers.license_or_access_constraints: NOAA public data; source-specific restrictions and flags remain part of provenance
providers.update_semantics: daily updates plus periodic reconstruction; NCEI assigns unique daily versions and values/flags can be revised, so responses used as evidence must be captured and digested
providers.revision_identity: catalog, inventory, and by-year inputs bind the exact provider URL to the captured artifact SHA-256; resumable HTTP capture additionally binds a stable remote validator and Content-Length; published observation partitions carry the captured compressed-artifact SHA-256 as source_revision and revisions use explicit supersession or tombstone lineage
